processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Sound portion of the 30 kg vacuum induction melted ingot homogenized at 1423 K for 2.5 h.
Hot rolled at 1323 K to a final plate thickness of ~13 mm; this condition is denoted HR.
Hot-rolled plates cold rolled by several passes to ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets); condition denoted HR+CR.

processing_steps.method: heat treatment in the two-phase region
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Cold rolled sheets heat treated in the range 873 K–1273 K for 1 h followed by water quenching; the sample of interest was heat treated at 973 K (HR+CR+973 K condition).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Zeiss Supra 55 FEG-Scanning electron microscope equipped with EDS and Nordley EBSD detectors from Oxford; analysed with TSL-OIM software
characterization_methods.key_findings: In HR+CR+973 K, 28Mn5Ni shows strongly elongated/banded (columnar) austenite grains aligned along RD with elongated dark stringer bands and mixed deformed + recrystallized austenite; recrystallized austenite fraction near zero and twin fraction near zero at 973 K.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Samples polished to colloidal silica ~100 nm finish; step size 120 nm (fine-grained) and 250 nm (coarse-grained) over ~100×100 μm² and ~200×200 μm²; three scans per sample; GOS <2° criterion; CSL Σ3 boundaries for twin fraction; linear intercept for grain size
characterization_methods.purpose: Grain orientations, grain size, twin fraction, recrystallization fraction (KAM/GOS), phase contrast

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Rigaku XRD instrument, Co-Kα radiation at 45 kV and 135 mA, beam size ~2 mm
characterization_methods.key_findings: Upon heat treatment at 973 K, additional peaks corresponding to κ-carbides and B2 appear (reported for 28Mn0Ni and 15Mn5Ni; B2 peaks more intense at 973 K than at 1173 K indicating higher secondary-phase fraction at lower annealing temperature).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: FEI TECNAI 20T G2 transmission electron microscope at 200 kV equipped with EDAX energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy
characterization_methods.key_findings: 973 K condition contains both κ-carbides and B2 in a mixed deformed/recrystallized austenite matrix; in 28Mn5Ni fine intragranular B2 (5–20 nm), intergranular B2 (50–200 nm) and κ-carbides were observed; κ-carbides coarsen (10–60 nm) in deformed austenite.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Specimens prepared by twin-jet electropolishing in mixed acid solution at 243 K (−30 °C); dark-field images captured from (010) κ-carbide satellite spots
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify phases present and their size/distribution; obtain B2 composition
characterization_methods.technique: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM), selected area electron diffraction (SADP) and EDS

characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn5Ni (HR+CR+1023 K) exhibited dimple morphology indicating ductile failure (contrast with quasi-cleavage in 15Mn5Ni).
characterization_methods.purpose: Fracture-surface morphology of failed tensile specimens

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: AFFRI Vickers hardness tester, peak load 30 kg (~300 N), dwell time 15 s
characterization_methods.key_findings: Bulk hardness of 28Mn5Ni increased with cold reduction (initial HR value ~268 ± 5 VHN) saturating near ~450 VHN at 50% cold reduction; on heat treatment hardness decreased monotonically with temperature (Fig. 8b).
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: ASTM E-140-02; values averaged over ten measurements per sample
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate hardness change with cold work and heat treatment

characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn5Ni in HR+CR+973 K: YS 1450 ± 15 MPa, UTS 1645 ± 10 MPa, TE 5 ± 1%.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: ASTM E8M; flat specimens (gauge length 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4–5 mm); room temperature; constant cross-head speed 0.5 mm min⁻¹ (initial strain rate ~3 × 10^-4 s^-1); triplicated
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate strength and ductility in various processing conditions

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Dislocations cut through fine κ-carbides, evolving into a slip band structure with a mean slip band spacing of ~200 ± 30 nm.

Non-shearable B2 particles act as obstacles to dislocation motion and cause early initiation of slip band refinement; refinement of slip band spacing was delayed at earlier deformation stages in alloys with coarse/high κ-carbide and B2 fractions.

interfaces.interface_notes: Prior B2 phase grains, heavily deformed with the γ matrix during cold rolling, were fully recovered and developed bamboo-type grain morphology; new B2 precipitates showed single-crystal-type orientations with some orientation relationship with adjacent γ grains (reported at 1173 K). Nucleation of recrystallized grains occurs mostly along γ/γ boundaries and γ/B2 interfaces.
interfaces.phase_evolution: Concurrent precipitation of κ-carbides and B2 upon heat treatment at 973 K (fine intragranular B2 5–20 nm, intergranular B2 50–200 nm and κ-carbides); intragranular B2 precipitation fraction decreases with increasing recrystallized austenite fraction.
interfaces.slip_behavior: Planar slip activity followed by dynamic slip band refinement; inhomogeneous slip band spacing developed in Ni-containing LDS alloys (including 28Mn5Ni) whereas the Ni-free 28Mn0Ni showed homogeneous slip band spacing under similar HR+CR+1173 K conditions.

defects.type: deformed austenite / stored strain (elevated local misorientation)

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: No noticeable growth of recrystallized grains in Ni-containing LDS alloys up to 1173 K
grain_structure.texture: In the 973 K condition the austenite is strongly banded/elongated along RD with elongated dark stringer bands.

phases_present.morphology: mixed strongly elongated/banded (columnar) deformed grains aligned along RD and fine recrystallized grains with annealing twins
prior B2 stringers plus intragranular and intergranular precipitates; in 28Mn5Ni fine secondary B2 precipitated mostly along grain boundaries at 973 K
fine uniformly distributed intragranular κ-carbides in recrystallized austenite; inhomogeneous and relatively coarse κ-carbides in deformed austenite

precipitates.distribution: uniformly distributed within recrystallized austenite grains
inhomogeneous and relatively coarse, aligned along deformation bands
within grains (fine, marked by broken yellow arrow in Fig. 6e/f for 28Mn5Ni)

precipitates.type: fine intragranular B2 (SEM-EBSD scale, all heat-treated samples)
coarser intergranular B2 (SEM-EBSD scale, all heat-treated samples)

precipitates.distribution: elongated stringers; ~4% B2 fraction in 28Mn5Ni in HR condition

structures.overall_structure: Mixed deformed and recrystallized austenite (partial recrystallization; recrystallized fraction near zero at 973 K) containing concurrent precipitates of κ-carbides and B2 particles, together with prior B2 stringers retained from the HR condition; three main features were noted: (a) deformed austenite, (b) recrystallized austenite with annealing twins and (c) secondary B2 phase.

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: YS/UTS in HR+CR+973 K and in all heat-treated conditions

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Tests triplicated; average of three readings reported.
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: flat tensile specimens, gauge length 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4–5 mm

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Engineering stress-strain curve of 28Mn5Ni in HR+CR+973 K (Fig. 9b, dashed red) shows the highest stress (~1500–1550 MPa) among heat-treated conditions but limited strain; true stress-strain and ln(σ)-ln(ε) curves shown in Fig. 9c,d.

unmapped_findings: Composition of the 28Mn5Ni alloy (Table 1, wt.%): Mn 28.1 ± 0.4, Al 8.6 ± 0.04, C 0.9 ± 0.01, Ni 4.8 ± 0.04, Fe balance.
TEM-EDS composition of B2 particles in 28Mn5Ni heat treated at 973 K (Table 2): Mn 16.3 wt%, Al 12.7 wt%, Ni 24.6 wt% (Mn 14.7 at.%, Al 23.3 at.%, Ni 20.8 at.%), balance Fe.

The B2 phase was FeAl-based but contained significant amounts of Mn and Ni, whose content varied with their content in the steel; the B2 phase was enriched with Ni content with increasing heat treatment temperature.
Prior B2 phase fraction in 28Mn5Ni in the HR condition was ~4% (compared with ~12% for 15Mn5Ni).

Bulk Vickers hardness of 28Mn5Ni: HR condition ~268 ± 5 VHN; increased with cold reduction and saturated to around 450 VHN at 50% cold reduction (Fig. 8a). Upon heat treatment hardness decreased monotonically with temperature; the 873 K value was just below 500 VHN; a specific numeric value for the 973 K condition is not reported (shown graphically in Fig. 8b).
In the HR+CR+973 K condition the 28Mn5Ni alloy showed significant ductility, unlike the 15Mn5Ni alloy which behaved brittle (tensile elongation <1%) at 973 K and 1023 K.
